WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS zone_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.insurstat
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(zone_count) AS total_count FROM grouped
)
SELECT grouped.insurstat, grouped.zone_count,
       1.0 * grouped.zone_count / total.total_count
FROM grouped
JOIN total ON total.total_count IS NOT NULL
